assets.prompt: Create a production game sprite asset for Hollowstead, a Halloween co-op survival game with illustrated 2D sprites in a 3D world. This asset is the CINDER STAFF. One isolated object, centered, transparent background, square canvas, 12% clear padding, no ground or shadow, no text, no frame, no extra objects. Full silhouette visible. Stand the staff nearly vertically, grip near the lower third. Strong readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Art direction for the entire Gravecraft collection: charming eerie hand-inked storybook illustration, confident thick near-black plum outlines, restrained flat cel shading, etched woodgrain only where it helps, warm ivory carved bones, dark charcoal crooked wood, tarnished antique bronze fittings, small dusty burgundy cloth ties, pale spectral mint (#9ce7c3) luminous accents. No photorealism, no glossy 3D rendering, no pixel art, no soft grey background. Staff design: crooked blackthorn pole topped with a small carved ivory jack-o-lantern skull enclosed by three bronze claw-like branches; a controlled mint ghost flame rising from the skull with a tiny amber ember heart. Two hanging bone beads and burgundy binding at the grip. Premium cohesive game item illustration, crisp alpha edges, broad bold shapes, details readable on mobile.

Same artist and same world. Transparent background, single object only, NO staff, no text, no panel, no floor or shadow. Entire object centered with generous 10% padding, square canvas. Use the attached staff ONLY as style/material/color reference. Create ONE production animation sprite atlas for its summoned skeleton companion. Transparent background. Strict regular grid of 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, twelve cells, no labels, no dividers, no text. Each cell contains exactly the SAME small full-body skeleton character at exactly the same scale and registration: feet centered at 90% cell height, head within upper 10%, no parts crossing a cell boundary. The same charming eerie hand-inked storybook style as the staff, dark plum outlines, warm ivory bones, oversized angular skull with mint ghostfire eyes, simple rib cage, short tattered burgundy scarf and shoulder cape held with an antique bronze skull clasp, stubby stylized legs, empty bony hands. NOT pixel art, not photoreal. Facing three-quarter RIGHT in ALL cells, two arms and two legs, clean alpha.
Row 1, left to right: 4 subtle idle breathing poses, shoulders and scarf rise then fall, feet planted.
Row 2: 4 walking cycle poses: right leg forward/left arm forward; passing feet; left leg forward/right arm forward; opposite passing feet. Clear alternating feet.
Row 3: 4 claw attack poses: pull right arm back and crouch; lean forward arm driving; extended right claw swipe with broad pale mint curved slash at hand; recover upright. Keep the character identity and silhouette exactly consistent across all 12 cells. Nothing else in the atlas.
